--- MULTI DECK ---

Brothers, I would like to raise a proposal that I have been interested in for many years. Why not release the MULTI DECK system in Standard Constructed tournaments with any number of players?

I think the ideal would be to keep the system of only 1 deck per player in big events, EX: Nationals, Continentals and Qualifiers

Built "normal", I think that the "MULTI DECK" system could be fully released,

Opening the possibility of the player, if desired, to change deck between rounds, being able to change a maximum of 1 deck time during the tournament, totaling up to 2 decks in the same tournament. At the final table, the player can choose only one deck that he played during the previous rounds

Remembering that the interest would be in Constructions events just to be valid in the main ranking

Att
